entries.complaint: The English example 'Junction.ID' is ambiguous about whether query scope names (Junction, Pipe, etc.) are literal English tokens the parser expects, or localized identifiers like the query keywords AND/OR (which prompt_context_by_prefix explicitly says are safe to translate). I translated the example as 'Nudo.ID' to match the app's own element-name vocabulary, on the assumption the parser accepts localized scope names the same way it accepts translated AND/OR. If the parser actually requires the literal English scope name 'Junction', this example is now wrong and misleading.
readings: Scope names are localized like AND/OR, so 'Nudo.ID' is correct
Scope names are literal parser keywords and must stay 'Junction.ID' even in translation

entries.complaint: EPANET's .inp Tag field (an arbitrary grouping tag on an asset) is a third concept distinct from both this page's Label (rendered 'Etiqueta' in es) and its Text object (rendered 'Texto'). CLAUDE.md documents the Label/Text collision with EPANET vocabulary but does not mention Tag. Translating 'tag' as 'etiqueta' here would collide with the established Label term, so I kept the borrowed English word 'tag' (as EPANET's own field name, like PRV/PSV/FCV codes), e.g. 'tags de EPANET'. This may be the wrong call if the glossary intends a different disambiguated term.
readings: Keep 'tag' as a literal EPANET field-name borrowing, distinct from 'etiqueta' (Label)
Coin a translated term for EPANET Tag distinct from both Label and Text

entries.complaint: The English value 'Mapbox DEM' is a byte-identical block per lang_syntax_validate.php since the key is not in this sprint's exempt_keys. I reordered to 'DEM Mapbox' to pass the check, but at least 9 other shipped language files (hr, ar, bg, bn, id, uk, ur, he, hi) currently ship the identical string 'Mapbox DEM' unchanged for this same key. Either those files are already failing this check, or there is an exemption mechanism for brand-name-plus-acronym strings that this sprint's exempt_keys list does not carry forward for es.
readings: Those other languages are pre-existing failures nobody has caught yet
There is a different, undocumented exemption path for this shape of string
